title: Quelccaya Glacier Full Day Tour from Cusco
short_description: An ideal program for acclimatized adventurers who want to experience the best of the Andes in a single journey, combining color, ice, and extraordinary landscapes.
long_description: Dare to live a unique adventure in the highest parts of the Andes. The Quelccaya Glacier Tour, Suyuparina takes you to impressive snow-covered mountains and eternal ice landscapes, Andean plains with vicuñas, and natural lagoons. This extraordinary experience is perfect for travelers seeking unique adventures filled with excitement, nature, and unforgettable photo opportunities.

seo_description: Enjoy a full day adventure to the Quelccaya Glacier, the largest tropical glacier in the world. Tour from Cusco with unique Andean landscapes.

days.title: Day 01 – Quelccaya Glacier Tour, Suyuparina – Full Day
days.text: Departure very early from Cusco (approximately 3:00 a.m.) heading south, crossing high Andean landscapes and rural communities until reaching the district of Checacupe. We continue to Phinaya, where we enjoy breakfast before traveling to the Suyuparina pass, one of the highest communities in Cusco. From here, a gradual hike of approximately 15 minutes begins toward the foothills of the largest tropical glacier in the world. Along the route, you will observe lagoons, curious formations on the glacier wall, small ice caves, lakes, snow-capped mountains, alpacas, and an almost untouched natural environment. Upon arrival at the glacier, free time for photos, guide explanations, and contemplation of the impressive glacier front. We then return along the same route to Phinaya for lunch, followed by the return journey to Cusco, arriving approximately between 8:00 and 9:00 p.m.

QUELCCAYA GLACIER TOUR
• Destination: Quelccaya Glacier
• Duration: 1 Day
• Maximum altitude: 4,800 – 5,100 m.a.s.l.
• Difficulty level: Moderate – High
• Tour type: Nature / Adventure / Glaciers
• Hiking time: 1 to 2 hours (approx.)
• Weather: Cold Andean climate
• Recommended for: Acclimatized travelers with good physical condition
• Not recommended: People with heart or respiratory conditions
